summary: YD Bio Ltd filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release of its full-year 2025 financial results. The filing reports a 17% revenue increase, a $13.2 million PIPE financing, and cash of $6.0 million; it discusses prior business combination with Breeze Holdings Acquisition Corp. in August 2025. No transaction-specific terms (price, premium, dates), board recommendation, or advisor are provided. This is a routine earnings disclosure, not a special-situation event. No risk-arb angle or structural deal mechanics exist; the filing merely updates financial performance.
